All results are .CC: ADOGE-USD.CC, ADZ-USD.CC, AIDOGE-USD.CC, AMB-USD.CC, ANG-USD.CC, ARGUS-USD.CC, ATL-USD.CC, BABYDOGE-USD.CC, BAD-USD.CC, BARA34141-USD.CC, BCUG-USD.CC, BIZZ-USD.CC, BNBTiger, BRISE-USD.CC, BUZZ-USD.CC (RSI 80.3, ADX 74.6, solid mover), DAI-USD.CC, etc. Many have ADX=0 and RSI=100 indicating illiquid/stale tokens.
reason: Returns crypto-only assets (.CC format confirmed), at_new_high signal correctly applied, no stocks or forex contamination. Result quality is diluted by illiquid token noise but the tool's data is correct.

defects.desc: Many crypto 52-week-high results have ADX=0.0 and RSI=100.0 or 0.0, indicating illiquid/zombie tokens with flat prices that trivially satisfy the 52-week high condition by never moving. These dominate the top results. No liquidity filter is applied and no warning is emitted — a blind client would receive mostly junk tickers at the top.
